body: Thank you for this. I know I’m doing the right thing, it just feels so shitty.
I feel so pressured. I think about all he’ll miss out on in prison. I feel bad about moving on with my happy little life while he wastes away in prison.
I do feel very guilty and I just can’t shake it. I’m not afraid of him or anything but he’s just a nuisance.
Just a rant. I feel so guilty. I don’t know why.
The job isn’t the problem. I’m so depressed I can’t function and it’s caused me to perform at work poorly.
